title: POTV ONE Enthusiast Accessories Kit
description:
Who is the “Enthusiast” Accessories Bundle for?

The POTV ONE Enthusiast Accessories Bundle is designed for seasoned POTV ONE users who are ready to take their sessions to the highest level. If you know what the ONE can deliver and want to push its boundaries, this bundle is for you.

It includes everything needed to maximize your ONE experience, featuring our signature POTV Planet Bubbler, a water pipe adapter, the Gordito Mini Bubbler, a dozen dosing capsules, and more essentials to elevate every session.

POTV Planet Glass Bubbler & Water Pipe Adapter

Serious hits require some serious cooling. Attach the POTV Water Pipe Adapter to your ONE and rip it hard through the POTV Planet Glass Bubbler to soften those lung-busting hits.

Hit it hookah-style with the included mini whip or dive in with direct draws with a removable glass mouthpiece. This large-capacity bubbler holds plenty of water, while the Perfect Blend percolator cools and softens each hit without losing any of the rich herbal flavors.

Bite-sized cooling with the POTV Gordito Mini

Take ultra-cooled vapor anywhere with the POTV Gordito Mini Glass Bubbler. This palm-sized bubbler is designed to handle dense sessions wherever you go, with more percolator holes and more water for cooling that rivals at-home bubblers.

The Scoop

Say goodbye to sticky fingers and messy loading with The Scoop, designed to keep your setup clean and your herbs untouched. This handy tool shovels the perfect amount with a wide-open scoop and tamps your loads with a flat side on the opposite end.

12 POTV ONE Dosing Capsules

We’re including a dozen dosing capsules to help power an entire day of vaping. You know the deal: Chain multiple sessions with minimal downtime and keep your vape cleaner for longer. More is better, right?

Includes three sets of POTV ONE Dosing Capsules for 12 total.

POTV ONE Capsule Caddy Insert

You need something to hold all of those dosing capsules, right? This Capsule Caddy Insert fits snugly inside the incldued tightvac container and holds up to 12 dosing capsules. Organize your stash by type, flavor profile, or by vaped/fresh with two different numbered columns. It even leaves some space for a stir tool, brush, or a boveda pack.

Two POTV ONE Concentrate Pads

One concentrate pad isn’t enough – the flavors mingle, and they start to blend between different blends. These extras will give your concentrates the distinction they deserve, and keep the sessions rolling while the original pad is soaking clean.

Just load the pad inside the included dosing capsule, place a small amount of concentrate (no bigger than a grain of rice) onto the pad, and it’s good to go! Set the temperature to 430°F / 221°C and take long, slow sips once it vibrates.

For use with waxes and solid concentrates only. Use the included dosing capsule and only a very small amount (no bigger than a grain of rice) when vaporizing concentrates. Use with liquid concentrates may ruin your device and is not covered under warranty.

POTV ONE Replacement Screens and Alcohol Swabs

Keep your ONE running smoothly with a set of replacement screens. These screens sit under the glass adapter to keep herbs from entering the mouthpiece, but they’ll collect debris over time. A quick screen swap will save you from deep cleanings.

For tougher cleanups, use Snaps prefilled cotton swaps to clean a messy ONE oven chamber. Just snap the blue line end to release alcohol to the other side and wipe away stubborn residue.

Cleaning Disclaimer: DO NOT insert anything into the dimpled stem when cleaning. Clean with warm water and a mild grease-cutting dishwashing detergent such as Dawn or isopropyl alcohol.

Return policy

We do not accept used accessories returned on their own. However, your items are eligible for return through our 30-day policy if they are unused and unopened.
